clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
Exrecutive ether.
Mr. Carl G. Barth may be appointed as an expert in shop management
at the Watertown Arsenal, Watertowvn, Massachusetts, at a salary of $50
per diem and expenses for each day his service will be given to the arsenal,
for such period as may enable him to make a conclusive test of his methods
in the operation of a manufacturing arsenal.
Wm H TAFT
